title: Spyglass: Now Officially Launched!
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official release of the Spyglass tool, now fully available to empower your workflow with its enhanced capabilities.

title: Enhanced File Control
summary: Effortlessly manage and customize the display of all your embedded files, from images to documents, with our intuitive new file control features.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Our brand new public roadmap provides full transparency into our progress, showcasing recently completed updates, features in progress, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a significantly improved checkbox experience with larger, more draggable elements and a sleek new design, making your task management smoother and more efficient.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Work together more seamlessly with improved real-time collaboration tools, making it easier to see and understand what your team is doing.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Item Visibility
summary: Empower seamless collaboration by making shared items and ideas instantly discoverable and fully accessible within your network.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Experience Noeko in your native language as we expand support to a wider array of global languages, making our platform accessible to everyone.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement in project growth, and complete transparency into our development.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map: Navigate Your World with Precision
summary: Unlock deeper insights and seamlessly kickstart your workflows by filtering your knowledge map with tags, timeframes, and shared content.

title: Powerful Search Filters and Personalized Collections
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge base with advanced filtering and sorting options, empowering you to create personalized, savable collections for instant access to relevant information.

title: Visualizing Linked Notes
summary: Get ready for a more intuitive and interactive experience as you effortlessly organize your thoughts with new, flexible ways to display and interact with linked content.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Soon, you'll be able to host Noeko on your own servers or subscribe to new premium plans for expanded features and dedicated resources, empowering you with ultimate control and flexibility.

title: Elevated Visual Themes
summary: We're refreshing our existing themes and introducing exciting new options to give your workspace a stunning, personalized look.

title: Accurate Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your experience by ensuring our welcome messages perfectly match the current time of day, making every interaction feel just right.

title: Faster Tag Management: Unapply Items Directly
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items by unapplying them directly from any tag view, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Unlock New Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate a wider range of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, to enrich your insights and streamline your research.
